# shieldbot -- Gloam shield bot (episode 4 walker, faces right)
# generated by tools/sprites/build.py -- do not edit by hand
# glow: eye lens, shield pane and lattice, magenta studs and vents
# the shield covers the front (right) from about 10 to 32 px above the anchor
frame 64 64
anchor 32 60
# move: heavy walk behind the shield; the shimmer sweeps up
anim move 10 loop 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7
anim idle 8 loop 8 9 10 11 12 13 14 15
# attack: shield bash (the walker brain does not use it yet)
anim attack 12 once 16 17 18 19 20 21
# hurt: the pane flickers magenta
anim hurt 12 once 22 23 24
